headline: OJK Integrates Insurance Data, LPS Protects Policyholders Starting 2028
summary: OJK and the Indonesia Deposit Insurance Corporation signed implementing rules for a policy guarantee program, integrating insurance data to protect policyholders from 2028.
why: The OJK supervises Indonesia's insurance and financial sectors, and the LPS guarantees deposits and policies, so these rules affect policyholder protection and trust in insurers.
original_headline: OJK Integrasikan Data Asuransi, LPS Lindungi Pemegang Polis Mulai 2028
